IN the exercise of the powers vested in the Election Commission by Section 7(1) of the Presidential Elections Act, No.15 of 1981, we do hereby appoint the Returning Officers mentioned by designation in Column II of the Schedule herebyfor Electoral District in the corresponding entry in Column I of that Schedule.
